Balla

Official builds of Balla, a chronological Bluesky client. This is Balla's own repository, not the F-Droid catalogue.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://balla.croft.click/fdroid/repo
